findings.root_cause_analysis: H-G4 incident run-20261118-514a0d9758 injects concurrent faults on two topologically disconnected service branches (auth-service and notification-service, scenario SC-08). The frozen DependencyCorrelator only traverses directed dependency edges from the single alert's primary service_id (api-gateway <- auth-service), and AlertDeduplicator keys per (service_id, environment, alert_type, window). Consequently, DeterministicInvestigator correctly diagnosed auth-service (primary_cause=1.0) with valid provenance, but never expanded scope to notification-service in the same incident dossier.
